blocks.text:
The programme includes transfers, main excursions and entrance fees to national parks. Domestic flights with Aerolíneas Argentinas are not included.

In Ushuaia, the itinerary combines Tierra del Fuego National Park, a Beagle Channel cruise and a full-day 4x4 safari. In El Calafate, the main excursion focuses on the Perito Moreno Glacier, while a free day offers the option of adding either of two glacier boat excursions. At Iguazú, the programme includes both the Argentine and Brazilian sides of the falls, with an optional boat adventure.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: This consolidated RU website body paragraph is absent as a standalone passage in Word. Material commercial conflict: RU says domestic flights are included, but the approved Word explicitly excludes all Aerolíneas Argentinas domestic flights; the approved English exclusion was preserved in this EN body rather than silently claiming a flight inclusion.
